content: {"praised":["Idris Elba delivers powerful, gentle yet tough performance.","Season is well written with compelling British murder mysteries.","New characters and stories make final episode shocking and satisfying.","Intense detective work showcases Luther's relentless determination.","Alice Morgan shines as a complex anti-hero."],"criticized":["Too many main characters dead, ending series abruptly.","Season quality is low, disappointing compared to earlier seasons.","Violence portrayed is repulsive and sickening.","Story feels mismanaged and poorly executed.","Lack of future episodes leaves unresolved plotlines."]}
